name: yumspin
description: YumSpin — Decide what to eat and how to cook it (PWA + Android & iOS via Capacitor)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add android && npm run cap:assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios && npm run cap:assets && npx cap sync ios
